title: Especialista em Eficiência Energética Pleno
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.


Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.


A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Levantar dados de campo junto às unidades de negócio (bombas, motores, pressões, vazões, faturas e medições elétricas) e construir baseline energético.
  • Realizar diagnósticos técnicos (ponto de operação vs. BEP, setpoints, perfil de carga, demanda, fator de potência e harmônicos).
  • Modelar soluções e elaborar business cases (VFDs, adequação de motobombas, correção de FP, rebatimento de pressão, geração distribuída fotovoltaica).
  • Elaborar termos de referência e memoriais técnicos, apoiando na equalização técnica de RFPs.
  • Acompanhar implantação e comissionamento das soluções, validando desempenho e resultados pós-projeto.
  • Executar planos de medição e verificação (IPMVP A/B/C/D), manter repositório de evidências e emitir relatórios de economia de energia.
  • Construir dashboards e análises (Excel/Power BI) para acompanhamento de KPIs e rotinas de melhoria contínua.


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Mecânica ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em eficiência energética/gestão de energia.
  • Domínio de sistemas de bombeamento e acionamentos (VFD/soft-starter), leitura de diagramas elétricos e grandezas de qualidade de energia.
  • Vivência com medidores/analisadores, tarifação e análise de faturas.
  • Conhecimento em M&V (IPMVP) e estatística básica (normalização por clima/produção).
  • Proficiência em Excel.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens recorrentes às unidades de negócio.


Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Certificações CMVP, CEM e/ou ISO 50001.
  • Conhecimento em Power BI.
  • Experiência prática em campo com medições e comissionamento energético.


Benefícios

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Kit office.


Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!


A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +800 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 33 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.


Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 21.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: React Native Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for React Native Senior Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Build and Maintain features for our React Native-based iOS Apps.

- Deliver high quality, scalable and heavily tested software.

- Work on a cross-functional team, partnering across engineering, product, design, and business functions.


Requirements:

title: Desenvolvedor de Dynamics 365 CRM
description:
Desenvolvedor de Software - Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM

Descrição da Vaga:

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor de Software talentoso e experiente para se juntar à nossa equipe. O candidato ideal terá uma sólida experiência com linguagens orientadas a objeto e será responsável por desenvolver, implementar e manter soluções de software que atendam às necessidades de nossos clientes.

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e customizar soluções utilizando Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM
  • Colaborar com equipes de projeto para entender os requisitos e traduzir em soluções técnicas.
  • Realizar testes e depuração de software para garantir a qualidade e funcionalidade.
  • Manter-se atualizado com as últimas tendências e atualizações do Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento com linguagens orientadas a objeto.
  • Conhecimento sólido em linguagens de programação como C#, .NET, Java.
  • Experiência com integração de sistemas e APIs.
  • Habilidade para trabalhar de forma independente e em equipe.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e resolução de problemas.
  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou área relacionada.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento com Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM
  • Certificações Microsoft Dynamics.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis.

title: Especialista / Analista de Sistema - Sênior (Desenvolvedor Oracle)
description:
Especialista / Analista de Sistema - Sênior (Desenvolvedor Oracle)


Sobre a Natcorp:


A Natcorp é uma HRTech nacional, com mais de 35 anos de experiência, sendo o maior Sistema de RH do Brasil , com mais de 30 módulos e funcionalidades. 


Atuamos na transformação digital do RH de grandes empresas, através do nosso sistema completo e que está em constante evolução alinhado com as novas tecnologias.


Respiramos inovação tecnológica e focamos em construir as melhores soluções tecnológicas para o mundo do RH, com foco em usabilidade, flexibilidade, alta tecnologia e evolução contínua.


Modelo de Trabalho:


  • PJ
  • Home Office / Híbrido / Presencial (À depender da distância entre o escritório e residência)
  • Em caso de Híbrido ou Presencial: São Paulo/SP - Zona Sul - Bairro Chácara Santo Antônio - Região do Morumbi Shopping


A missão:


  • Atuar em inovação, projetos de customizações, desenvolvimento de novas soluções, sustentação e suporte.
  • Atuar como par técnico do tech lead.
  • Apoiar o tech lead em receber demandas, realizar discovery com cliente, mapeamento, desenho de solução viável (viabilidade técnica + UX/UI).
  • Desenvolver hands-on.
  • Conduzir a entrega end-to-end.
  • Detalhar escopo, quebrar em tarefas, estimar e executar o desenvolvimento.
  • Preparar alternativas técnicas e submeter recomendações para aprovação do tech lead.
  • Especificar arquiteturas de APIs, modelos de dados e planos de testes.
  • Participar de reuniões internas com equipes de produto e clientes para alinhamento técnico, tirar dúvidas e registrar decisões.
  • Garantir qualidade (padrões de código, performance, segurança, LGPD) e documentação para handover.
  • Acompanhar go-live e estabilização, reportando status, riscos e impedimentos ao tech lead.


As decisões finais, aprovações e acompanhamento ficam com o tech lead, onde estará atuando em conjunto de forma estratégica.


Stack que utilizará:


  • OCI (Oracle Cloud Infrastructure)
  • Oracle Database 19c
  • ORDS (Oracle Rest Data Service)
  • Oracle APEX 19.2 (PL/SQL, Javascript, CSS, HTML, jQuery, XML, JSON)
  • Forms 11g
  • Reports 11g
  • APIs RESTful utilizando ORDS
  • Webservices em Java e NodeJS
  • Azure Face API
  • Azure OpenAI
  • App mobile em VueJS (Android e iOS)
  • n8n


Requisitos:


  • Superior completo.
  • Inglês intermediário.
  • Desenvolvimento de Softwares e Aplicativos.
  • Senioridade comprovada em Oracle Database 19c, Oracle PL/SQL, Oracle APEX (PL/SQL, Javascript, CSS, HTML, jQuery, XML, JSON), ORDS, consumo e construção de APIs.
  • Experiência com APIs REST, webservices (Java/NodeJS) e integração entre sistemas.
  • Modelagem de Dados.
  • Arquitetura de Sistemas.
  • Perfil analítico, organizado e hands-on, confortável em atuar sob direção técnica e com cliente.


Diferenciais:


  • Conhecimento em UX/UI aplicada (critérios de usabilidade e viabilidade técnica).
  • Experiência com Vue.js / Angular / Azure Face API / Azure OpenAI.
  • Experiência com n8n.
  • Observabilidade (logs/metrics).
  • Tuning de performance.
  • Inteligência Artificial.
  • Análise e Ciência de Dados.
  • Cybersecurity.


Soft Skills:


  • Comunicação
  • Inteligência Emocional
  • Organização e Planejamento
  • Gestão de recursos
  • Aprendizado contínuo


Se você curte inovar, construi e resolver problemas reais com tecnologias Oracle, então venha construir o maior Sistema de RH do Brasil.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack Sênior

  • Implementar e promover boas práticas de engenharia de software, incluindo código limpo, testes unitários/integração, code reviews e integração/entrega contínua

  • Mentorar desenvolvedores juniores e plenos, atuando como referência técnica, compartilhando conhecimento e contribuindo para o crescimento do time

    • Contribuições em projetos open source ou participação ativa em comunidades tech (meetups, conferências), demonstrando iniciativa e paixão pela área
    • Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas

    • Benefícios: pacote de benefícios negociável , de acordo com as necessidades do profissional (a ser discutido durante a proposta)

title: Analista de aEEG / EEG
description:
Quem somos: A PBSF é uma instituição que une tecnologia e inteligência artificial para fazer a monitorização cerebral 24x7, com aplicação de metodologias capazes de prover diagnóstico precoce e neuroproteção em recém-nascidos de alto risco. Uma empresa brasileira, formada por médicos neonatologistas, a PBSF é respeitada mundialmente, possuindo parcerias internacionais com a Microsoft, Universidade de Stanford, Colégio Imperial de Londres, entre outros. No Brasil, sua rede de parceiros é composta por maternidades privadas, ranqueadas entre os melhores hospitais do mundo e por importantes unidades do Sistema Único de Saúde (SUS).


Descrição do Cargo:

Estamos à procura de um Folguista de Analista de aEEG / EEG que será responsável pela triagem dos exames em tempo real, e prestará suporte técnico remoto para o time de enfermagem que realiza a instalação do exame a beira leito.


Requisitos:

- Técnico em Enfermagem concluído.

- Desejável experiência em UTI Neonatal e/ou em Eletroencefalograma

- Noções de Informática


Escala de trabalho:

- Escala 12x36 (Folguista) - home office aos finais de semana e feriados (quando coincidir com a escala)

- Treinamento e desenvolvimento profissional.

- Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e colaborativo.


Forma de contratação: CLT - escala 12x36 (Folguista)

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer (C#/.NET/React.js)
description:
We're looking for full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Software Engineers with 7+ years of experience delivering production-ready software. The ideal candidates will have recent hands-on C# /.NET, modern JS framework (Vue.js, React.js (preferred), Angular), and extensive end-to-end API and integration experience. You should thrive in fast-moving environments and be able to quickly translate ambiguous goals into working features, rapidly master new tools, and own your code from design through post-release support.

You'll collaborate with Senior and Staff engineers across North and South America, owning features from concept through production support and seeing users benefit almost immediately. If delivering practical solutions quickly and refining them in live environments motivates you, you'll fit right in.

Founded in 2003, our client transforms the traditional restaurant point-of-sale (POS) terminal into an integrated 360-degree operational management system. Their solution enhances brand loyalty through improved customer experiences, optimizes operations to result in lower costs, and boosts sales volumes through comprehensive analytics and employee performance insights. Over 7,000 restaurant locations utilize their technology today, processing more than $5 billion in payments annually.


Responsibilities:

  • Perform full life-cycle commercial software development and maintenance, including analyzing specifications, documenting requirements, and architecting, designing, developing, and maintaining software solutions
  • Collaborate with teams to design, develop, and produce high-quality code following best practices and standards for both new features and existing application maintenance
  • Own features end-to-end - UI through API and Data layer too
  • Support and refactor legacy code using modern methodologies and technologies
  • Analyze code to identify defect root causes and provide resolutions
  • Participate in daily standups and weekly team meetings to review priorities, progress, new ideas, and technologies
  • Address defects identified during various testing cycles
  • Perform high-quality peer reviews


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and spoken English; must be able to discuss trade-offs with teammates and stakeholders
  • 7+ years professional C#/.NET (Core and Framework) experience - recent in the last 2 years
  • Modern JavaScript framework experience, preferably React.js (Vue.js, OR Angular) - delivering new features, not just fixing bugs
  • Comfortable working end-to-end (UI, API, data layer, infra scripts); whatever it takes
  • Must have "ownership mindset" - you'll have the responsibility of designing, building, shipping, monitoring, and fixing the features you touch
  • Fluent in Git and modern branching / PR workflows
  • Rapid learner as you're expected to ramp up on a new library or API in hours, not weeks
  • Team first approach displaying transparency, reliability, decisiveness, and a laser focus on customer impact
  • Rapid learner as you're expected to ramp up on a new library or API in hours, not weeks


Desired Experience (Not Required)

  • Daily use of Docker/containers (you wrote the Dockerfile)
  • Azure PaaS (Container Apps, SQL, Cosmos DB, etc.)
  • Track record of expanding scope of responsibility over time (e.g., owning more complex features, introducing new tooling)
  • Obsession with metrics, logging, and user impact


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with innovative and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human, let's learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are committed to delivering world-class remote resources that enable our valued client team members to work effectively. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Especialista de Tecnologia – Dados & Analytics
description:
Será responsável por planejar, executar e otimizar processos de coleta, tratamento e análise de grandes volumes de dados, transformando informações em insights estratégicos que apoiem a tomada de decisão em todas as áreas da empresa. Atuará com ferramentas de Data Warehousing, Data Factory e Power BI, assegurando a qualidade, integridade e segurança dos dados corporativos, além de acompanhar tendências como o Microsoft Fabric.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar a coleta, transformação e integração de dados provenientes de múltiplas fontes, utilizando ferramentas de ETL e pipelines de dados;
  • Estruturar e manter ambientes de dados (Data Lake, Data Warehouse) garantindo desempenho, governança e escalabilidade;
  • Desenvolver e gerenciar conjuntos de dados e modelos analíticos para relatórios e dashboards interativos no Power BI;
  • Aplicar técnicas de análise avançada, modelagem estatística e machine learning para geração de insights preditivos e prescritivos;
  • Garantir a governança, qualidade e segurança das informações, assegurando conformidade com normas e legislações como LGPD e GDPR;
  • Automatizar processos de integração e análise de dados, promovendo eficiência e inovação contínua;
  • Colaborar com equipes de negócio e tecnologia para identificar oportunidades de uso estratégico dos dados e apoiar iniciativas de transformação digital.


Requisitos e Certificações:

  • Experiência sólida em engenharia e análise de dados, com domínio de Power BI, Azure Data Factory e Data Warehousing;
  • Certificações Microsoft DP-900 (Fundamentos de Dados) e DP-700 (Power BI) são altamente desejáveis;
  • Conhecimento ou interesse em Microsoft Fabric será considerado um diferencial estratégico;
  • Certificação DP-203 (Data Engineering on Azure) é um diferencial para compreender e evoluir pipelines legados.

title: Data Analyst (Sales Focus)
description:
About YipitData:

YipitData is the market-leading data and analytics firm. We analyze billions of data points every day to provide accurate, detailed insights across industries, including consumer brands, technology, software, and healthcare.

Our insights team uses proprietary technology to identify, license, clean, and analyze the data that many of the world’s largest investment funds and corporations depend on. We raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation over $1B, further accelerating our growth and market impact.

We have been recognized multiple times as one of Inc’s Best Workplaces. As a fast-growing company backed by The Carlyle Group and Norwest Venture Partners, YipitData is driven by a people-first culture rooted in mastery, ownership, and transparency.

With offices in New York, Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, Seattle, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and Singapore, we continue to expand our reach and impact across global markets.


Why You Should Apply NOW:

  • The Data Feeds team manages the data feeds business at YipitData. We partner with systematic and quantamental investment firms by providing access to alternative data for investment analytics and model development.
  • Become part of a growing team where your ideas and collaboration will have a direct impact on how we deliver value to top-tier investment firms.


About The Role:

YipitData seeks a proactive, analytically minded Sales Engineer with +2 years of experience to join our dynamic team. This role will directly influence the growth of our data feed revenue. As a Sales Engineer, you will provide our clients with operational and quantitative development support , enabling them to utilize and evaluate YipitData’s data feeds effectively.


We expect East Coast work hours.


As Our Sales Engineer, You Will:

  • Provide operational support during client onboarding, with a strong focus on the setup, configuration, and integration of complex data feeds (40% daily focus).
  • Partner closely with Sales to drive product adoption by delivering demonstrations, analyses, and explanations of complex data feeds to clients.
  • Address client queries and maintain strong relationships by ensuring our data solutions align closely with clients’ investment strategies.
  • Develop quantitative documentation, scripts, and use-case examples to facilitate client evaluations, integrations, and ongoing data usage (60% daily focus).

title: Vendedor
description:
Vaga para Vendedora em Clínica de Transplante Capilar

Você é apaixonada por vendas e deseja atuar em um mercado em crescimento? Venha fazer parte da nossa equipe!

Estamos em busca de uma vendedora dedicada para integrar nossa clínica especializada em transplante capilar. Se você tem facilidade de comunicação, gosta de desafios e está em busca de uma oportunidade que valorize seu potencial, essa vaga é para você!


Responsabilidades:

- Atendimento ao cliente, fornecendo informações detalhadas sobre os serviços de transplante capilar.

- Prospecção de novos clientes e manutenção de um bom relacionamento com os já existentes.

- Acompanhamento de todas as etapas do processo de vendas, garantindo a satisfação do cliente.

- Fechamento de vendas e acompanhamento pós-venda.

- Cumprimento das metas estabelecidas pela equipe de vendas.


Requisitos:

- Experiência prévia em vendas, preferencialmente no ramo da saúde ou estética.

- Habilidade de comunicação e persuasão.

- Foco em resultados e superação de metas.

- Proatividade, organização e comprometimento.


O que oferecemos:

- *Salário fixo*  compatível com o mercado.

- *Comissão atrativa *:

- *Vale transporte* e *vale alimentação*.

- Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e de fácil acesso.

- Oportunidade de crescimento dentro da empresa.

Horário de trabalho:

Segunda a sexta-feira das 9h às 18h

Sábado das 9h às 13h

Se você está pronta para se juntar a um time vencedor e ajudar nossos clientes a alcançarem os resultados dos sonhos, envie seu currículo e venha conquistar grandes resultados com a gente!

*Vem ser nossa estrela!*

description:
A Job? Or a Lifetime Experience? Start Yours Here!


**Please note that we're aiming at an expatriation to Portugal**


We are a Portuguese technology consulting company with a strong outward look to the rest of Europe. We have 12 years of experience in the market and reached the status of “large company” in 2018. We now have more than 350 associates and we keep growing, with offices in Lisbon, Porto, and Leiria , as well as projects in more than 20 countries. Our company is part of the national top 10, with a growth of 250% in the last years.


Work-life balance is part of our DNA. We focus on win-win-win relationships, defining every moment of interaction as an experience with unique conditions. Working with Affinity is a “Lifetime Experience ” where you will have the opportunity to demonstrate all your potential and to be successful on every level.


#welcometoyourfuture


What you'll need to have

  • Experience with ElasticSearch, Prometheus, and Kibana.
  • Advanced knowledge of Kubernetes and hands-on experience with cloud providers (AWS, Azure or GCP)
  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools like Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • Experience with CI/CD (e.g., GitLab CI, Jenkins, ArgoCD).
  • Scripting knowledge in Bash, Python, or equivalent.
  • Experience in monitoring and troubleshooting distributed systems.
  • English proficiency (minimum B2 level).
  • Availability to relocate and live in Portugal with our support;


Also good to have:

  • Knowledge of Kubernetes and cloud security.
  • Familiarity with full-stack observability.
  • Kubernetes certifications (CKA, CKAD) are valued.


What we expect from you

  • Will to exceed expectations (your own and the ones defined by Affinity);
  • Exceptional skills and the will to acquire more;
  • Good people skills (not just in terms of technology, language, and platforms), team spirit, and pleasant disposition;
  • Autonomy, proactivity, and focus (even under pressure);
  • Obsession for doing things right, and ability to prioritize;
  • Versatility (you can be a fan of BYOD or not);

What will encourage you

  • Being part of a company that has a disruptive action in the technology market;

  • Accessing a generative career directly proportional to your performance and interest;
  • The real possibility of being part of our company staff.

title: React Tech Lead - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for React Tech Leads to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Build a framework for other developers to build applications with. Initially focusing on building reactive dashboards with an option to make mobile versions of them.

- Assist in coaching and mentoring other React developers.


Requirements:


- 7+ years of experience in Front End development with strong skills in Javascript, CSS3 and HTML5.

- 2+ of experience developing Web applications using ReactJS, Flux, Redux, Relay, etc.

- Experience using ES2015 (ES6 / ES7).

- Experience with command lines, APIs, and client-side performance.

- Familiar with the concepts of basic programming, JavaScript and data structures, types of variables and idiosyncrasies.

- Comfortable using debuggers and code tracking.

- Proven experience in the use of Jasmine or similar tools for Front End testing.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

As a DevOps Engineer, you will make a significant contribution to infrastructure automation, continuous delivery, observability, and security by collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. The DevOps engineer evaluates emerging technologies, promotes process improvements, and shapes standards and best practices while providing expert guidance to project teams across the organization. This role plays a fundamental role in driving the adoption of cloud platform capabilities in collaboration with software engineering, architecture, and information security teams


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Deploy & Configure AWS Cloud Services;
  • Deploy & Configure Kubernetes resources;
  • Help elaborating or contributing to RFC and ADRs documents describing technical solutions;
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC) – Automate infrastructure deployment;
  • CI/CD Pipeline Automation – Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions;
  • Observability & Monitoring – Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions;
  • Disaster Recovery & Security – Develop automated backup strategies, define disaster recovery plans, and implement security best practices;
  • Workflow Automation & Integration – Build integrations to automate deployment processes, security checks, and operational workflows.



Essential Skills

  • Experience in a DevOps role, with hands-on AWS experience;
  • Experience with IaC tools, ideally Terraform and Helm Charts;
  • Experience with containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools like CircleCI and GithubActions;
  • Experience with AWS services (EC2, S3, ECS, EKS, RDS, Lambda, VPC);
  • Knowledge of security best practices for cloud environments;
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills;
  • Familiarity with Ruby or Golang;
  • Proficiency in scripting languages (Bash, Shell, or Python).



Highly Desirable Skills

  • Networking & Security – Familiarity with DNS, Zero Trust, load balancing, IAM, firewall rules, VPNs, and cloud security best practices;
  • Monitoring & Observability – Experience using Datadog, CloudWatch;
  • Experience with Kubernetes packet managers (e.g. Helm, Kubectl);
  • AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Associate or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate.


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Sales representative
description:
ABOUT US


Property Leads is a premium Pay-Per-Lead company that generates high-quality, inbound, motivated seller leads for real estate investors. We are a team of ambitious, results-driven individuals with bold goals for both our company and our personal growth. While many companies describe themselves as a family, we see ourselves as a high-performance sports team, focused, competitive, and committed to winning.

We're looking for someone who is motivated, friendly, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is ready to take on challenges head-on.

THE ROLE


We’re hiring a dynamic and driven Sales & Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team. This role is responsible for selling motivated seller leads to both inbound and outbound prospects, managing their pipeline, and serving as a key point of contact in our customer journey.

This is more than just a sales role, as you’ll be the first impression of Property Leads. Professionalism, strong communication skills, great English, and the ability to build rapport quickly are essential. You should be passionate about helping people succeed and eager to grow within a fast-moving organization.

This role is best suited for individuals with at least one year of experience in commission-based sales.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Conduct onboarding calls, schedule new appointments, and nurture leads in the pipeline

  • Manage and optimize our CRM to enhance lead tracking, segmentation, and conversion

  • Analyze lead data and provide actionable insights to improve sales and outreach

  • Ensure timely follow-up and accurate documentation of all client interactions

  • Work closely with the Sales Manager to drive performance and refine processes

    • QUALIFICATIONS

    • 1+ years of commission sales experience

    • Strong

    • 1+ years of CRM management experience, ideally in real estate or lead generation

    • Proficiency in CRM platforms (e.g., GoHighLevel) and Airtable

    • Strong problem-solving skills

    • This role requires strong proficiency in both written and verbal English. You should be comfortable drafting emails, participating in meetings, and handling client interactions.

    • Self-motivated and collaborative with a strong sense of accountability

    • Self-aware and heavy emphasis on constant self-improvement.

    • WHAT WE OFFER

    • Competitive base pay with performance-based bonuses

    • Remote-friendly work environment

    • Clear paths for career advancement and professional development

    • Supportive, high-performing team culture

title: Network Operations Analyst (L1/L2 NOC – Early Shift) - LATAM
description:
SONDA is the largest IT service provider in Latin America, leader in systems integration, support and IT outsourcing. With almost 50 years of experience and in constant growth around the World, and growing so far in in US, as well.


We are looking for a Network Operations Analyst to join our client’s Early Shift team, providing first-line monitoring and coordination of network incidents across multiple retail locations. This professional will act as the main communication point between the client and the Managed Service Provider (MSP), ensuring timely updates, incident tracking, and clear communication with internal stakeholders.


Location: Nearshore (LATAM)

Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, from 5:00 AM to 12:00 PM ET

Model: Remote


Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor network events and incidents, escalating as needed (L1/L2 NOC equivalent).
  • Coordinate with the Managed Service Provider for updates and resolution progress.
  • Communicate incident status, impact, and resolution details to the Early Shift team.
  • Track, document, and report network incidents following established SLAs and procedures.
  • Support escalation and root cause analysis processes when required.
  • Maintain up-to-date records of communication, incident logs, and service documentation.


Requirements

  • Experience in Network Operations , NOC , or related technical support roles.
  • Basic understanding of network infrastructure (LAN/WAN, routers, switches, connectivity).
  • Familiarity with incident management and ticketing systems .
  • Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Excellent organizational and coordination abilities.
  • Availability to work from 5:00 AM to 12:00 PM ET (early shift).


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in retail network environments or with Managed Service Providers (MSPs) .
  • Exposure to network monitoring tools (e.g., SolarWinds, Zabbix, Nagios, PRTG).
  • Basic certifications such as CompTIA Network+ or CCNA are a plus.

title: Gerente de vendas
description:
Local: Belém – PA

Tipo: Presencial / Tempo integral


Sobre a LiveMob:

A LiveMob é uma empresa especializada em soluções de mobilidade e acessibilidade, oferecendo cadeiras de rodas e equipamentos ortopédicos que proporcionam liberdade e qualidade de vida. Nossa missão é simples: fazer as pessoas viverem em movimento .


Descrição da vaga:

Buscamos um(a) Gerente de Vendas com perfil estratégico, liderança e foco em resultados, para gerenciar a equipe comercial e impulsionar o crescimento da marca na região.


Responsabilidades:

  • Planejar e executar estratégias comerciais e campanhas de vendas;
  • Gerenciar equipe de consultores e metas individuais;
  • Realizar acompanhamento de indicadores e relatórios de desempenho;
  • Negociar com clientes corporativos e parceiros;
  • Identificar oportunidades de mercado e novos canais de venda.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada em gestão de vendas ou coordenação comercial;
  • Conhecimento em produtos hospitalares, ortopédicos ou mobilidade (desejável);
  • Habilidade em liderança, negociação e comunicação interpessoal;
  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Gestão Comercial ou áreas afins.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com e-commerce ou vendas digitais;
  • Perfil empreendedor e orientado a metas.


Benefícios:

  • Remuneração compatível com o mercado + bônus por resultados;
  • Oportunidade de crescimento em empresa em expansão;
  • Ambiente colaborativo e voltado à inovação.

title: Analista de processos de sistemas
description:

  • Serviços de gestão de processos;
  • Acompanhar, atualizar e diligenciar Planners e mesas de atendimento indicadas pelo gestor do serviço;

Academia Stefanini - plataforma com cursos online, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

title: Desenvolvedor(a) de Software Backend SR
description:
Sobre o BS2

Somos um banco 100% digital e focado em empresas, com atendimento humanizado e soluções sob medida para cada cliente - afinal, nenhum negócio é igual ao outro. Essa lógica também se aplica à nossa cultura: temos um DNA inovador que instiga todo o nosso time a se reinventar constantemente. Por aqui, nossos colaboradores (os bessers) podem contar com um ambiente que impulsiona o crescimento da carreira e traz a oportunidade de lidar com os desafios do mercado financeiro com quem mais entende do assunto.


A área tem o foco em crédito PJ, com produtos voltados para capital de giro e diversas garantias (FGI, Pronampe, antecipação de recebíveis, notas promissórias).


Principais responsabilidades

  • Participar de todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento: concepção, codificação, testes, implantação e sustentação.
  • Atuação com alto volume de transações e demandas regulatórias do mercado financeiro.
  • Atuar em projetos fim a fim, com forte interação com áreas de negócio e produto.
  • Resolver problemas em produção, com autonomia e visão crítica.
  • Trabalhar em squads multidisciplinares, com líderes técnicos e product owners.


Principais Tecnologias:

  • Linguagem principal: C# (.NET 6, 7 ou 8)
  • Angular – conhecimento é diferencial, não eliminatório.
  • Cloud: Google Cloud Platform (GCP) – conhecimento é diferencial, não eliminatório.
  • Arquitetura: Microsserviços
  • Banco de dados: SQL e NoSQL (ex: BigQuery)
  • Ferramentas de DevOps: Esteiras automatizadas, acompanhamento com SREs
  • Containers: Kubernetes (diferencial)


Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida como desenvolvedor(a) sênior, com entregas completas de projetos.
  • Capacidade de comunicação com áreas de negócio e entendimento de regras.
  • Vivência com resolução de problemas em produção.
  • Perfil generalista, com visão ampla do processo de desenvolvimento.
  • Desejável: experiência no mercado financeiro.


Modelo de Trabalho:

Remoto, com preferência para candidatos de São Paulo ou Belo Horizonte.


Nossos benefícios:

️ Vale refeição no valor de R$ 1.003,48 ao mês;

title: Project Manager - ClickUp Expert (BR)
description:
Our client is a fast-growing digital agency helping construction, remodeling, and home service businesses grow through our Local Growth Engine (LGE) system — combining high-converting websites, local SEO, Google Business Profiles, Local Service Ads (LSA), and Meta ads.


Our client doesn't sell fluff. They drive real jobs, leads, and growth for contractors across the U.S. Their systems are dialed, their results are proven — and now they’re looking for an operator who can keep their fulfillment engine running at full speed.


Role Overview:

This role is a hybrid between Project Manager/ClickUp Expert and Fulfillment Specialist — you’ll lead communication, manage timelines, and own execution on our core services , including Google Business Profile (GBP), LSA setup, and SearchAtlas SEO tasks. You’ll be the heartbeat of delivery and work closely with our designers, SEO tools, and ad systems.


Key Responsibilities:


Project + Account Management

  • Run all project tracking inside ClickUp: templates, statuses, timelines, QA
  • Keep 5–10 active clients on track — coordinating copy, design, SEO, and approvals
  • Follow up relentlessly to gather missing items from clients and internal team
  • Maintain clear documentation and visibility across all deliverables


Client Communication

  • Be the point of contact in Slack and email for client updates and check-ins
  • Set expectations, hold timelines, and respond to blockers or issues
  • Deliver updates via Slack, Loom, or email to keep communication proactive


Fulfillment – GBP, LSA & SearchAtlas SEO

  • Handle full Onboarding.
  • Google Business Profile access, setup, and optimization
  • Lead LSA setup : gather requirements, submit info, monitor status, and troubleshoot
  • Execute SearchAtlas tasks : integrations, tasks according to SOPs, schedule deliverables, monitor progress, and QA outputs
  • Input data into AI templates (Claude) for sitemaps, ICPs, copy, and tracking
  • An understanding of SEO—specifically on a project management basis—is a major plus. Experience with Search Atlas or similar SEO tools also a huge advantage.


SOP + System Improvement

  • Build, refine, and enforce SOPs across onboarding, LSA, SEO, and project management
  • Maintain ClickUp templates, Claude folders, and Google Drive systems
  • Ensure all tasks follow a scalable, repeatable process — and help improve it as we grow


ClickUp Expert

  • Building end-to-end workflows, not just managing tasks, but architecting spaces, folders, and automations for agency ops (project intake, creative approvals, inbound tickets, recurring QA checklists, etc.).
  • Setting up, customizing, and automating dashboards for real-time team performance, client progress, and KPI tracking—using custom fields, formulas, integrations, and advanced automations (Zapier, Make, webhooks, etc.), not just default views.
  • Implementing logic-based automation (task assignments, dependencies, reminders, status changes) that eliminate manual work and enforce processes.
  • Troubleshooting and building project templates that actually drive adherence—not “just use the default template” thinking.


Requirements:

  • Must have recent experience in managing fast-growing teams in digital agencies.
  • Must have advanced ClickUp capability and be the single point of truth and accountability for all things ClickUp—owner, architect, and enforcer.
  • Proven ClickUp + Slack skills (this is your command center)
  • Strong follow-through and communication — you stay on top of details
  • Experience with Google LSA setup , GBP , and basic SEO workflows
  • Able to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced remote team
  • Fluent in written English with strong documentation skills


Bonus (Not Required)

  • Experience with SearchAtlas or similar SEO platforms
  • Webflow familiarity (for helping QA builds)
  • Comfortable using Claude/ChatGPT to create SOPs, briefs, or client docs
  • Prior work in a digital agency, marketing ops, or local service business


Benefits:

  • Client Relationship : You will be directly working with the client. This means that you will communicate with the client, provide services, and address any client-related matters independently.
  • Payments : All payments for your services will be handled by the client. Elevate and Delegate is not involved in processing your payroll. Your salary will directly go to you. 
  • Vacation Leaves and Holidays : While we may have recommendations or guidelines regarding vacation leaves and holidays, the decision is entirely at the discretion of the client. You are expected to align your schedule with the client’s business needs and any specific policies or preferences they may have in this regard. 


Salary : $1500/month

Timezone: EST

Role type: Full-time

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Company Description

With 18 years of experience in technology, DEVELL has delved into the field of Generative Artificial Intelligence since its inception, positioning itself as a significant player in a market full of endless possibilities. Our deep understanding and practical application of Generative AI make us the ideal partner for companies looking to explore and maximize the potential of this revolutionary technology. At DEVELL, we convert emerging opportunities into tangible solutions that drive innovation and growth.


Role Description

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer (TypeScript) to join our growing engineering team. You will work on high-impact projects, contributing to front-end and back-end solutions that demand scalability, maintainability, and architectural elegance.


This is not just about coding – we want someone who can design abstract solutions, implement complex features, and influence technical decisions that shape our platform for years to come.


Responsibilities

  • ⁠Architect, design, and implement scalable full-stack applications using TypeScript.
  • Build and maintain back-end services with NestJS.
  • Contribute to front-end development using at least two frameworks among Angular, React, Svelte, or Vue.
  • ⁠Design modular and abstract solutions that reduce complexity and improve maintainability across projects.
  • ⁠Collaborate with cross-functional teams (AI, product, design, and infrastructure) to deliver robust solutions.
  • Review code, mentor peers, and promote best practices in software engineering.
  • Take ownership of complex features from concept to production.


Qualifications

  • ⁠Mandatory: Strong proficiency in TypeScript.
  • Mandatory: Proven experience with NestJS.
  • Mandatory: Experience in at least two front-end frameworks among Angular, React, Svelte, Vue.
  • Solid understanding of software architecture patterns (DI, modularization, micro frontends, event-driven, etc.).
  • Experience building and maintaining complex, scalable systems.
  • Strong grasp of CSS, HTML5, responsive design, and UI performance optimization.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking.
  • Excellent communication skills in English and ability to collaborate in remote-first teams.
  • A mindset for clean code, testing, and maintainability.


Nice to Have

  • ⁠Experience with microservices or event-driven architectures.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure), and containerization (Docker/Kubernetes).
  • ⁠Knowledge of design systems and component-driven development.
  • Experience with AI-powered applications.
  • Experience managing internal packages using private registries (npm, Verdaccio, GitLab, etc.).
  • ⁠Hands-on experience with bundlers (Webpack, Vite, esbuild, Nx).

title: Trust Accountant Support Trainer
description:
Trust Accountant Support Trainer


Location: Brazil, fully remote

Type: Full-time, 8hours/day

Availability: ASAP to 2 weeks

Rate: 5,000 BRL to 14,000 BRL per month

Level: Junior to Senior

Setup: PJ/Consultancy

Industry: Hospitality/Accommodation/Rental

Experience:

  • Accounting or Bookkeeping (Required)
  • Onboarding Clients to understand Accounting

Equipment: Needs to have own machine, equipment not provided



Job Description

Do you have a strong accounting background but want more variety than balance sheets and reports? Do you enjoy teaching others, solving problems, and helping people succeed? If so, this role might be the perfect fit.

As a Software Accounting Trainer / Onboarding Specialist, you’ll play a key role in guiding new clients in the vacation rental industry through their onboarding process. You’ll ensure proper setup of taxes, fees, and trust accounting, and train clients on how to use the software system effectively to stay compliant and confident. This role blends accounting expertise with training, customer service, and problem-solving in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead onboarding and transition sessions for new vacation rental clients, ensuring accurate accounting system setup.
  • Train clients via Zoom on all accounting functions within the system, including trust accounting.
  • Perform and review accounting tasks such as:
  • Bank and non-bank account reconciliations
  • Entering transactions and journal entries
  • Preparing Trial Balance and Trust reports
  • Reviewing client entries for errors and developing correction plans
  • Identify misplaced or invalid data, troubleshoot issues, and ensure timely resolution.
  • Respond to support tickets and client calls promptly, providing clear, professional guidance.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships through exceptional customer service.
  • Write and update knowledge base articles to support client and internal education.
  • Lead webinars and group training sessions for clients and staff on accounting best practices.
  • Document and analyze client questions and escalate issues when necessary.
  • Collaborate with instructional design and internal teams to create and improve training resources.
  • Participate in team meetings and internal projects, contributing to process improvements and knowledge sharing.


Qualifications & Requirements

title: Engenheiro de dados GCP
description:
Estamos em busca de um Engenheiro de Dados com sólida experiência na construção e otimização de pipelines de dados. Este profissional terá papel fundamental no desenho, desenvolvimento e manutenção de soluções de integração de dados confiáveis, escaláveis e seguras. O candidato ideal deve ter forte conhecimento em plataformas de nuvem, práticas modernas de engenharia de dados e perfil analítico para garantir o fluxo eficiente de dados na organização.

Responsabilidades Principais

Projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines ETL/ELT para ingestão, transformação e entrega de dados estruturados e não estruturados.

Implementar frameworks de ingestão de dados a partir de múltiplas fontes (bancos de dados, APIs, arquivos, streaming etc.).

Garantir qualidade, consistência e confiabilidade dos dados por meio de validação, monitoramento e testes automatizados.

Otimizar fluxos de processamento de dados visando custo e performance.

Colaborar com Cientistas de Dados, Analistas e áreas de negócio para fornecer datasets limpos, confiáveis e bem documentados.

Trabalhar com serviços nativos de nuvem (ex.: BigQuery, Dataproc, Dataflow, Databricks, Snowflake) para implementar arquiteturas escaláveis.

Aplicar boas práticas de CI/CD, versionamento e Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) em pipelines de dados.

Assegurar conformidade com normas de segurança, governança e privacidade (ex.: PII, GDPR, LGPD).

Qualificações Necessárias

Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência comprovada em engenharia de dados, com foco em construção de pipelines.

Domínio em SQL, Python e Spark.

Experiência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (Google Cloud Platform, AWS ou Azure).

Sólidos conhecimentos em modelagem de dados, data warehouse e arquiteturas lake/lakehouse.

Vivência com ferramentas de orquestração (Airflow, Cloud Composer, Prefect, Dagster).

Familiaridade com práticas de DevOps (Git, pipelines CI/CD, Terraform ou similares).

Diferenciais Desejáveis

Experiência com streaming em tempo real (Kafka, Pub/Sub, Kinesis).

Conhecimentos em containerização (Docker, Kubernetes).

Vivência com pipelines de machine learning e MLOps.

Experiência com catálogos de dados, metadata management e ferramentas de governança.

Competências Comportamentais

Perfil analítico e orientado à resolução de problemas.

Capacidade de comunicar conceitos técnicos complexos de forma clara a públicos não técnicos.

Trabalho em equipe, postura proativa e colaborativa.

Inglês fluente (escrito e falado);

espanhol será considerado um diferencial.

title: Generative AI Engineer
description:
Location: Remote (Applications open worldwide)

Compensation: $20,000 – 40,000 / year (based on experience and scope of ownership)

Skills: Semantic Search, Vector Databases, Prompt Engineering, GenAI Frameworks, React Agents, Graph Agents, Document Parsing, Python, Scalable APIs


About AnswerThis


AnswerThis is an AI-powered research platform built to eliminate the most time-consuming part of academic research: the literature review. We serve researchers globally, from PhD students to academic professionals, helping them go from query to a comprehensive, cited review in minutes.

Our system understands how papers connect, ranks relevance, summarizes insights, and maps citations. This removes weeks of manual work. But that is just the beginning. We are building a vertically integrated AI research suite that streamlines every stage of academic discovery.

If you want to design algorithms that directly accelerate science in medicine, AI, climate, and more, this is the place to do it.


The Role


We are hiring an AI Engineer to lead the development of the core intelligence behind AnswerThis. This role requires deep expertise in information retrieval, scalable backend systems, and generative AI.

You will:

  • Build and optimize semantic search pipelines, graph-based retrieval, and agentic systems.
  • Design and deploy scalable APIs and services capable of serving hundreds of concurrent requests.
  • Architect, implement, and productionize vector databases and embedding-based retrieval systems.
  • Work on GenAI integrations including react agents, graph agents, prompt engineering, and LLM orchestration.
  • Set up full-stack search engines from scratch that can handle real-world academic workloads.
  • Contribute directly to the infrastructure that makes cutting-edge science more efficient.


This is a hands-on role with real ownership. You will move fast, experiment, and ship production systems that impact thousands of researchers worldwide.

title: TypeScript Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

We are looking for Typescript Developer to join our company, and collaborate with team members to build flexible, scalable, and maintainable mobile apps. Key responsibilities:


- Plan, develop and implement user interface strategy.

- Work on the design, look, and feel of our web properties.

- Work with designers and developers to develop modern, intuitive user interfaces for our web properties.

- Improve JS and CSS quality by conducting code analysis, and recommending changes in policies and procedures.

- Continuously improve the user experience.

- Research user preferences.

- Research new technologies and best practices.

- Work in a team environment with shared code; disciplined use of source code control and process documentation.

- 5+ years of experience with TypeScript.

- Software development experience, preferably secure, scalable web applications in JavaScript (React, Vue), HTML, CSS, SCSS, and JQuery.

- Experience with AJAX, XML, JSON, and best practice design patterns.

- A solid understanding of design principles/patterns and test-driven development using Unit Testing (Jest or equivalent).

- Experience with caching systems and knowledge of User Experience design methodologies will be an added advantage.

- Critical thinking and problem-solving skills.

- Great interpersonal and communication skills.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Arquiteto de Soluções- Oracle
description:
Resumo

Profissional responsável por desenhar, implementar e evoluir soluções de integração e middleware, garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e aderência às melhores práticas de arquitetura. Atua como referência técnica em plataformas SOA / OAG (Oracle API Gateway, Oracle SOA Suite) e em arquiteturas serverless com AWS Lambda, alinhando integrações legadas a soluções modernas em nuvem.

Principais Responsabilidades

Definir e manter a arquitetura de middleware (on-premises e cloud), suportando integrações críticas entre sistemas, parceiros e APIs externas.

Projetar soluções com OAG e Oracle SOA Suite, assegurando governança, segurança e políticas de API.

Liderar a migração e/ou modernização de integrações para AWS Lambda e outros serviços nativos da AWS (API Gateway, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, Step Functions).

Atuar na definição de padrões de integração, protocolos (REST, SOAP, JMS, eventos) e estratégias de mensageria.

Estabelecer guidelines de observabilidade e monitoramento (Dynatrace, CloudWatch, ELK).

Garantir alta disponibilidade e performance em integrações de missão crítica.

Apoiar squads e times de desenvolvimento na adoção de boas práticas de middleware e nuvem.

Conduzir avaliações de impacto técnico e provas de conceito (POCs) em novas tecnologias de integração.

Requisitos Técnicos

Middleware / SOA

Experiência com Oracle SOA Suite (BPEL, OSB, Mediator, Adapters).

Conhecimento profundo em Oracle API Gateway (OAG) e gestão de políticas de segurança (OAuth, JWT, rate limiting, throttling).

Integração via SOAP, REST, JMS, MQ, FTP, DB adapters.

Experiência com arquiteturas orientadas a serviços (SOA) e microsserviços.

Cloud (AWS)

Experiência em AWS Lambda e arquiteturas serverless.

Integração com API Gateway, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, Step Functions.

Conhecimentos em IAM (Identity and Access Management) e segurança em nuvem.

Monitoramento com CloudWatch e boas práticas de observabilidade.

Arquitetura

Definição de roadmaps de modernização para integrações legadas.

Aplicação de padrões de integração (EAI, ESB, event-driven).

Conhecimento em arquitetura de APIs (API-first, design RESTful, OpenAPI/Swagger).

Experiência em middleware híbrido (on-premises + cloud).

Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas.

Desejável

Experiência com Kong, Apigee ou outros API Gateways.

Conhecimento em containers (Docker, Kubernetes, OKE, EKS).

Certificações Oracle ou AWS (ex: AWS Solutions Architect Associate/Professional).

Experiência em projetos com migração para nuvem.

title: Engenheiro de Software (Java) (Exclusiva para Pessoa com Deficiência)
description:
Estamos contratando um(a) Software Engineer Mid Level para integrar o Billing Team no Brasil.


Este time é responsável por toda a plataforma que processa vendas, renovações de assinaturas e fluxos de receita, criando registros de recebíveis de clientes, além de gerenciar processos de cobrança (dunning).


As soluções desenvolvidas envolvem integrações globais com motores de cálculo de impostos, respeitando as complexidades de cada mercado, bem como a geração e envio de documentos fiscais às autoridades locais. O time também processa eventos de diversas fontes, transformando-os em lançamentos contábeis integrados ao ERP da empresa.


Seu impacto


Executar projetos estratégicos junto a um time de engenheiros(as) de software altamente qualificado;

Desenvolver soluções que suportam o processo de revenue recognition e contabilidade global da Wellhub;

Trabalhar em conjunto com um time de ~9 engenheiros(as) mid/sênior, implementando, testando e entregando soluções;

Atuar de forma hands-on, com foco em qualidade e escalabilidade;

Participar de melhorias em serviços existentes, como billing calculate e bill orchestrate, além de iniciativas voltadas para usuário e assinaturas



✅ Quem é você


Formação em Ciência da Computação ou experiência equivalente;

Experiência em engenharia de software, com histórico de entregas de qualidade;

Experiência em Java/Kotlin + Spring (RESTful APIs);

Conhecimentos em SQL (PostgreSQL) e NoSQL (DynamoDB);

Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços e entendimento de escalabilidade;

Interesse em aprender mais sobre arquiteturas orientadas a eventos e Serverless;

Conhecimento em Cloud Computing (AWS) e Cloud Native (Kubernetes);

Inglês intermediário (essencial para documentação, comentários e comunicação interna), com abertura para evoluir

title: Sap Materials Management Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for SAP MM ,Remote in Morumbi-Sao Paulo who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)



Remote, but must be available for occasional visits to Morumbi-SP when requested by the client.

Must Have Skills

'Run functional activities for PTP(Procure to pay) such as Purchasing, Pricing/Procedure, Tax Code Creation, Support SAP Notes for Tax Reform context and prerequisites, support Developers in code remediation, new developments, run IT and integration testing, support user testing (UAT).


Will participate in SAP Tax Reform Project in a Lifescience Company, running activities for PTP(Procure to pay) in Purchasing, Pricing/Procedure, Tax Code Creation, Support SAP Notes for Tax Reform context and prerequisites.


Functional experience with SAP MM, integration with other application, Brazilian SAP Localization knowledge, especially for NFe Inbound knowledge, Pricing and enhancements to supply processes, Experience with Project, Upgrade, Implementation and Rollout Projects


Good Have to skills

'Experience working with multiple teams in different regions.

Experience with SAP DRC, Sovos, One Source and Easyway.

SAP S/4HANA Rise experience.

English advanced and Spanish Intermediate.


Key Responsabilities

'As a Functional Consultant, will be responsible for work in Blueprint requirements, back to standard on SAP Localization main topics for Brazil, SAP Customizing/Settings, SAP Notes support to Basis and ABAP team, Unit testing execution, Business and User Acceptance testing support, Transition of requirements to customer stakeholders, key users training, Hypercare/stabilization support (+7yrs experience).

Will be responsible for resolving any SAP issues reported by the business users and delivering all enhancements and upgrade issues as required by business users.

Responsible for completing all tasks assigned by team lead and project manager.

Responsible for reviewing solutions designed by the team members and proposing improvements.

Responsible for proactively working with business users for identifying and resolving recurring issues.

Owner of certain niche processes within broader domain area.

Experience in a Professional LifeScience/Pharma company is an asset.


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Analista de Sistemas .Net Pleno
description:
Descrição da Empresa Handcom é especializada em fornecer soluções de software para gestão de armazéns e centros de distribuição. Com o nosso sistema Mobilize WMS, oferecemos uma solução completa para otimizar e gerenciar eficientemente as operações logísticas dos nossos clientes. A Handcom também fornece soluções de gestão de ativos e inventários utilizando RFID através do Mobilize IoT. Fundada em 2007, temos casos de sucesso reconhecidos no mercado nacional e somos premiados pela Fundação Nacional da Qualidade com o prêmio faixa ouro. Nosso propósito é empoderar pessoas que movem o mundo para o futuro.


Descrição do Cargo Estamos buscando um Analista de Sistemas .Net Pleno para se juntar à nossa equipe. Este cargo envolve desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações .Net, garantindo performance e qualidade do código. As responsabilidades incluem a implementação de novas funcionalidades no sistema, realização de testes, depuração e otimização. Este é um cargo de tempo integral dedicado e remoto.


Experiências Exigidas – Desenvolvedor Pleno .NET C#

Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento back-end com .NET/C#

  • Vivência prática de pelo menos 3 anos  atuando em projetos profissionais.
  • Desenvolvimento de APIs e serviços com ASP.NET Core .


Excelência em acesso a dados com Entity Framework Core

  • Experiência em criação, manutenção e otimização de consultas LINQ e SQL.
  • Uso avançado de migrations, mapeamento de entidades e relações complexas.
  • Ajuste de performance em queries e análise de planos de execução.


Prática em desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful

  • Implementação de endpoints seguros, versionados e performáticos.
  • Integração com sistemas externos e consumo de serviços.
  • Documentação de APIs (Swagger, OpenAPI).


Aplicação de boas práticas de engenharia de software

  • Experiência comprovada com Clean Code, SOLID e princípios de design .
  • Criação de código escalável, legível e sustentável.
  • Participação em code reviews  e manutenção de padrões de qualidade.


Experiência em análise de performance e troubleshooting

title: DevOps Analyst Senior – Focus on .NET – Advanced/Fluent English
description:
DevOps Analyst Senior – Focus on .NET – Advanced/Fluent English


***About Us

DEXIAN, launched in 2023, has a global presence and brings with it almost 30 years of experience through its legacy companies, mainly from the combination of DISYS and Signature Consultants.

We started in Brazil in 2007 as DISYS and, since then, we have acquired more than 60 clients from different sectors of the economy. As DEXIAN, we have become one of the largest companies in staffing solutions, IT solutions, and workforce supplementation. We are leading the industry by delivering unique services that combine global scale, full-service projects, and tactical agility to modernize hiring models. We support our clients in finding the best way to address their talent gap, in order to support their digital transformation process. We have strategically located offices in four major capitals: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ), and São Paulo (SP). Thus, we are able to stay close to our clients and consultants. We are also a Minority Owner Company and are proud to have been born into diversity.


***What to expect from us

People are at the heart of our strategy and make up our greatest asset. We are committed to attracting and retaining the best talent and building real, lifelong connections. Therefore, we act as a bridge between highly qualified professionals and consistent, thriving opportunities. We believe that bringing the right talent, technology, and organizations together helps unlock transformative results and achieve new levels of success for the clients we serve and the consultants we hire. And for that, five fundamental values guide us: Integrity, Transparency, Authenticity, Ingenuity, and Empathy. DEXIAN is committed to corporate social responsibility and invests in programs that support diversity and inclusion.

If you share these same values, this is the place for you!


***Our Client

This position will serve our client in the wholesale and retail segment, focused on the manufacturing and marketing of household and industrial appliances in general.


***Position Context

You will work on a project dedicated to the global team.


***What to expect from your daily work

The work will focus on DevOps. There will be no coding involved

- Develops activities involving operational support and systems engineering to build and execute scalable, distributed, and fault-tolerant solutions;

- Collaborates with solution architects and full-stack developers on the continuous improvement of the platform, following the pillars of the Azure Well-Architected Framework;

- Creates CI/CD pipelines to build, test, release, and deploy scalable, reliable, and secure applications effectively and efficiently within the framework;

- Develops system monitoring and alerting features, leveraging observability tools;

- Executes and improves the platform's .NET Core backend services;

- Responsible for the implementation and best practices of IaC;

- Global support for incidents in the cloud infrastructure;

- Execution of the platform's FinOps process;

- Promotes, applies, and maintains our global security and application standards.


***What you need to have

- Higher education, preferably in IT;

- Availability to work from 6:00 AM to 3:00 PM;

- Advanced/fluent English;

- Knowledge of .NET, but the daily focus is DevOps, you will not be working with coding;

- Previous experience as a DevOps engineer.


***Where you will work

From the comfort of your home. 100% Home Office.


***Note

Working hours: BRAZILIAN (BRT) from 6 AM to 3 PM. This schedule was chosen to allow more hours of interaction with the team that works on Central European Time (CET). When the schedules do not coincide, you must be available for on-call support.


***Employment Type

CLT (Brazilian Labor Law)


***Benefits for you

- Meal Voucher;

- Food Voucher;

- Medical Assistance;

- Dental Assistance;

- Life Insurance;

- Gym Pass;

- Pet Allowance.


***In addition, we offer:

- Study incentive after completing 1 year at Dexian;

- Development and training program;

- Leadership Track training.


***Process steps:

• Language leveling - Consulting;

• Chat with HR - Consulting;

• Technical conversation with the client.

title: Senior Rust Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Senior Rust Software Engineer to deliver high-quality, high-performance systems. You'll be writing Rust-first code to tackle complex systems challenges, acting as a technical leader on client projects, and independently designing robust, scalable, and memory-safe solutions. You will champion best practices and elevate the engineering bar for mission-critical applications:


Must-have skills:

- Expert-level proficiency in the Rust programming language, including a deep understanding of core concepts like the Ownership Model, Borrow Checker, Lifetimes, Traits, and Macros.

- Strong background in systems programming concepts, including multithreading, concurrent programming, and performance-critical application development.

- Extensive experience with asynchronous programming in Rust, particularly using frameworks like Tokio and understanding the nuances of async/await.

- Proven experience designing and implementing highly scalable backend services and distributed systems.

- Proficiency with the Rust toolchain, including Cargo , and strong experience with version control systems (Git) and CI/CD pipelines.

- Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of tackling and resolving complex architectural and coding challenges.


Nice-to-haves:

- Ideal experience working with video processing related projects with real time systems and web containers.

- Ideal experience utilizing webRTC , real time system response, publishing on multiple platforms.


The icing on the Kake:

  • Competitive Pay in USD – Work globally, get paid globally.
  • Fully Remote – Simply put, we trust you.
  • Better Me Fund – We invest in your personal growth and passions.
  • ❤️ Compassion is Badass – Join a community that invests in social good.

title: SDR | EXECUTIVO DE VENDAS | JÚNIOR
description:
Na Klooks, transformamos informações financeiras difíceis de acessar em dados claros, organizados e prontos para serem usados em decisões importantes. É por isso que algumas das maiores empresas do mundo, como Bloomberg, S&P e Moody’s, já confiam em nós. No Brasil, bancos como Itaú e Santander também utilizam nossos serviços, assim como centenas de consultorias que acessam todos os dias nossa plataforma.


Agora queremos escalar esse serviço — e precisamos de você para fazer parte dessa jornada.


Se você gosta de vendas consultivas, tem interesse por finanças e tecnologia, e se motiva em entender os desafios dos clientes para fechar negócios estratégicos, esse é o lugar certo para você crescer.


Perfil desejado – o que esperamos de você


Buscamos um(a) profissional com perfil consultivo e analítico , que saiba

construir relações de confiança com os clientes e conduzir negociações de forma estratégica. É essencial ter escuta ativa, curiosidade para entender diferentes modelos de negócio e habilidade para traduzir dados e soluções técnicas em benefícios claros para o cliente.


Skills e competências que valorizamos

  • Experiência em vendas B2B , especialmente com ciclos consultivos e soluções complexas (SaaS, dados, tecnologia ou serviços financeiros);
  • Conhecimento de técnicas de vendas consultivas como Spin Selling;
  • Habilidade para entender o cenário do cliente , mapear dores e propor soluções alinhadas ao valor da Klooks;
  • Capacidade de apresentar e negociar propostas comerciais com diferentes níveis de decisão.
  • Conhecimento ou interesse por indicadores financeiros , análise de balanços mercado financeiro e inteligência de dados;
  • Conhecimento em Excel/Google Planilhas e apresentações, Google Slides/PPT.
  • Cumprir a cadência de contato com os leads, realizar follow ups e acompanhar a evolução do funil de vendas;
  • Perfil orientado a metas, dados e performance;
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Capacidade de organização e gestão do pipeline via CRM;


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com soluções baseadas em dados;
  • Familiaridade com demonstrações financeiras;
  • Vivência em startups, fintechs, consultorias financeiras ou empresas de tecnologia;


Oportunidade

  • CLT - Tempo integral
  • Trabalho 100% remoto
  • Fixo de R$ 3.000 + Comissão (em média R$ 500 / mês mas podendo chegar a R$ 2.000)
  • Vale alimentação
  • Wellhub (Gympass)
  • Plano de Saúde com coparticipação
  • Day Off no dia de aniversário


Gostou? Envie seu CV para com o assunto Executivo de Vendas | Closer - Klooks

title: Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.


The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.


Data Cloud Consultant

Skills:

It is desirable that the candidate has a Salesforce Certified Data Cloud Consultant certification, and should have experience in implementing and consulting on enterprise data platforms in a customer-facing role, including design, configuration, and solution architecture.


Recommendation:

Experience in implementing and working with strategy and data modeling, including building multiple solutions on Salesforce clouds.

- Have experience in development, strategy, business analysis, pre-sales solutions, or architecture.


Job Description:

Responsible for conducting customer discussions around requirements and technical drawing.

Development of software programs by technical specifications following programming standards and procedures, performing unit tests, performing program modifications and responding to problems by diagnosing and correcting logic and coding errors.

Ensure that secure coding and UI standards and best practices are applied during development.

Provide inputs and contribute to the improvement and maintenance of applications and programs.

Leading efforts to configure, analyze, design, develop, and maintain program code and applications.

Execution of detailed and complex unit tests and secure code testing and troubleshooting.

Conducting and supporting the source code management process.

Contributing to integration, systems and performance testing and code tuning.

Participation in secure code peer reviews.

Definition and promotion of opportunities for the reuse of code, configurations, procedures and techniques.


Requirements:

Degrees in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field are preferred.

Fluency in English to conduct technical meetings with offshore team, support teams and customers outside Brazil.

Experience with Data Architecture

Experience in writing SQL queries and data modeling, as well as governance and architecture performance practice and guidelines

Proficient in migrating data from traditional applications to Salesforce using the Import Wizard and Data Loader utility

Experienced in handling multi-country deployments and managing multiple instances of Salesforce.com

Experience with setting up and customizing managed Field Service packages is a plus.

title: Analista de BI Sênior
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de BI com forte domínio em Power BI , perfil consultivo, com atenção especial à experiência do usuário e à estética das entregas.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver dashboards e relatórios interativos em Power BI , com foco em usabilidade, performance e impacto visual.
  • Atuar como parceiro estratégico das áreas de negócio, entendendo suas necessidades e propondo soluções analíticas que gerem valor.
  • Garantir a integridade, consistência e atualização dos dados utilizados nas análises.
  • Aplicar princípios de UX/UI para melhorar a experiência dos usuários com os produtos de BI.
  • Realizar análises exploratórias e gerar insights acionáveis para diferentes áreas da companhia.
  • Documentar processos, modelos e boas práticas para garantir escalabilidade e governança.
  • Contribuir com a evolução da cultura data-driven na organização.
